Patient Name: Ryan Grant
DOB: 05/05/1981
MRN: MRN-18588

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Grace Allen, Kestrel Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of fatigue in the setting of a strong family history of early heart disease.

Ryan Grant is a 45-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism.

He reports several months of persistent fatigue. His father had heart disease at an early age, and his brother developed heart disease before age 50. He denies chest discomfort or shortness of breath.

I am asking your cardiology team to evaluate his fatigue in the setting of this strong family history of early heart disease.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Grace Allen
Kestrel Family Practice
